declarations.title: Original actual auxiliary polynomial
declarations.statement:
∀ (c δ hcap : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    c < 1 →
      0 < δ →
        δ < 1 →
          0 ≤ hcap →
            have B := ⌈max (4 / c) (32 * (1 + c ^ (-1 / 2)) / (c * δ))⌉₊;
            have K0 := ⌊2 * ↑B / c⌋₊;
            have κ := 2 * K0 * (K0 + 1) ^ 2 + 1;
            ∃ X,
              1 < X ∧
                ∀ (x D E ρ₀ : ℝ) (M : ℕ) (h : ℤ),
                  have U := x ^ (1 / 2) * D ^ (-3 / 2);
                  have V := x ^ (1 / 2) * E ^ (-3 / 2);
                  X ≤ x →
                    1 / 2 ≤ D →
                      1 / 2 ≤ E →
                        h ≠ 0 →
                          |↑h| ≤ hcap →
                            x ^ c ≤ D * E →
                              x ^ c ≤ U * V →
                                x ^ c ^ 2 ≤ ↑M →
                                  ↑M ≤ x →
                                    9 / 8 * (1 + δ) * Real.log (D * E) * Real.log (U * V) /
                                          Real.log x ≤
                                        Real.log ↑M →
                                      D / (2 * E) ≤ ρ₀ →
                                        ρ₀ ≤ 2 * D / E →
                                          have ν := Real.log (U * V) / Real.log (D * E);
                                          have A := ⌊↑B * ν⌋₊;
                                          let H := (A + 1) * (B + 1);
                                          have ep := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq ⋯).symm;
                                          A ≤ K0 ∧
                                            B ≤ K0 ∧
                                              ∃ C,
                                                C ≠ 0 ∧
                                                  (∀ (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ),
                                                      |↑(MvPolynomial.coeff m C)| ≤ x ^ κ) ∧
                                                    (∀ m ∈ C.support, m 0 ≤ A ∧ m 1 ≤ B) ∧
                                                      ∀ (w : Fin 4 → ℕ),
                                                        D < ↑(w 0) ∧
                                                            ↑(w 0) ≤ 2 * D ∧
                                                              E < ↑(w 1) ∧
                                                                ↑(w 1) ≤ 2 * E ∧
                                                                  U < ↑(w 3) ∧
                                                                    ↑(w 3) < 2 * U ∧
                                                                      V < ↑(w 2) ∧
                                                                        ↑(w 2) < 2 * V ∧
                                                                          ρ₀ < ↑(w 0) / ↑(w 1) ∧
                                                                            ↑(w 0) / ↑(w 1) ≤
                                                                                ρ₀ * (1 + 1 / ↑M) ∧
                                                                              ⋯ = ↑h →
                                                          MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom ℝ)
                                                              ![↑(w 0) / ↑(w 1), ↑(w 2) / ↑(w 3)]
                                                              C =
                                                            0

declarations.title: Decomposition And Envelope
declarations.statement:
(have powerful := fun m => ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ^ 2 ∣ m;
  ∀ (n k : ℕ),
    2 ≤ k →
      powerful (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (n + i)) →
        have Pk := ∏ p ∈ Finset.range k with Nat.Prime p, p;
        have f := fun i => ∏ p ∈ Finset.range k with Nat.Prime p ∧ Odd ((n + i).factorization p), p;
        have d := fun i => ∏ p ∈ (n + i).primeFactors with k ≤ p ∧ Odd ((n + i).factorization p), p;
        (∀ (i : ℕ),
            1 ≤ i →
              i ≤ k →
                (∃ u, 0 < u ∧ n + i = f i * d i ^ 3 * u ^ 2) ∧
                  f i ∣ Pk ∧ Squarefree (d i) ∧ (d i).Coprime Pk) ∧
          ∀ (i j ui uj : ℕ),
            1 ≤ i →
              i ≤ k →
                1 ≤ j →
                  j ≤ k →
                    i ≠ j →
                      n + i = f i * d i ^ 3 * ui ^ 2 →
                        n + j = f j * d j ^ 3 * uj ^ 2 →
                          (d i).Coprime (d j) ∧
                            (d j).Coprime (f i * ui) ∧ ↑(ui.gcd uj) ^ 2 ∣ ↑j - ↑i) ∧
  (have powerful := fun m => ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ^ 2 ∣ m;
    ∀ (n k : ℕ),
      2 ≤ k →
        powerful (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (n + i)) →
          have Pk := ∏ p ∈ Finset.range k with Nat.Prime p, p;
          have f := fun i =>
            ∏ p ∈ Finset.range k with Nat.Prime p ∧ Odd ((n + i).factorization p), p;
          have dk := fun i =>
            ∏ p ∈ (n + i).primeFactors with k ≤ p ∧ Odd ((n + i).factorization p), p;
          ∀ (i j ui uj : ℕ),
            1 ≤ i →
              i < j →
                j ≤ k →
                  n + i = f i * dk i ^ 3 * ui ^ 2 →
                    n + j = f j * dk j ^ 3 * uj ^ 2 →
                      have d := f i * dk i;
                      have e := f j * dk j;
                      have u := f j * ui;
                      have v := f i * uj;
                      have h := f i ^ 2 * f j ^ 2 * (j - i);
                      ↑e ^ 3 * ↑v ^ 2 - ↑d ^ 3 * ↑u ^ 2 = ↑h ∧
                        d ^ 3 * u ^ 2 = f i ^ 2 * f j ^ 2 * (n + i) ∧
                          1 ≤ h ∧
                            h ≤ k * Pk ^ 4 ∧
                              d.gcd e ∣ Pk ∧
                                ↑(u.gcd v) ≤ √↑k * ↑Pk ^ 2 ∧
                                  n = d ^ 3 * u ^ 2 / (f i ^ 2 * f j ^ 2) - i) ∧
    (∃ K,
        0 ≤ K ∧
          ∀ (η : ℝ),
            0 ≤ η →
              η ≤ 1 / 1000 →
                ∀ (a a' : ℝ),
                  19 / 100 - η ≤ a →
                    a ≤ 21 / 100 + η →
                      19 / 100 - η ≤ a' →
                        a' ≤ 21 / 100 + η →
                          have s := a + a';
                          have t := 1 - 3 * s / 2;
                          have m := 9 / 8 * s * t;
                          have lst := max (max ((s - m) / 2) (a - m)) (a' - m);
                          have tst :=
                            max (max ((t - m) / 2) ((1 - 3 * a) / 2 - m)) ((1 - 3 * a') / 2 - m);
                          m + 3 / 10 * lst + 1 / 5 * tst ≤ 38059 / 160000 + K * η) ∧
      ∀ (a b : ℝ),
        0 ≤ a →
          a ≤ 1 / 3 →
            0 ≤ b →
              b ≤ 1 / 3 →
                2 / 27 < a + b →
                  have s := a + b;
                  have t := 1 - 3 * s / 2;
                  have m := 9 / 8 * s * t;
                  have lst := max (max ((s - m) / 2) (a - m)) (b - m);
                  have tst := max (max ((t - m) / 2) ((1 - 3 * a) / 2 - m)) ((1 - 3 * b) / 2 - m);
                  m ≤ m + 3 / 10 * lst + 1 / 5 * tst

declarations.title: Lattice Tails
declarations.statement:
∀ (D E x : ℝ),
  1 / 2 ≤ D →
    1 / 2 ≤ E →

        ∀ (M : ℕ),

            have V := x ^ (1 / 2) * E ^ (-3 / 2);
            have ρ₀ := fun j => D / (2 * E) * (1 + 1 / ↑M) ^ j;
            have ω₀ := fun j => ρ₀ j ^ (3 / 2);
            have J := {j | D / (2 * E) ≤ ρ₀ j ∧ ρ₀ j ≤ 2 * D / E};

declarations.name: JocelynWorkspace.Formalization.PowerfulCounting.CountingClosure.Erdos137Final.counting_thm_k3
declarations.title: Conditional: for fixed k ≥ 3, #{n ≤ x : (n+1)(n+2)…(n+k) powerful} ≪ x^(77/320+ε), with the central subcount ≪ x^(38059/160000+ε) (Stewart, CCDN, Gelfond)
declarations.hypothesis: Stewart Thue bound; CCDN bound for integral affine curves (N = 12); Gelfond height inequality
declarations.statement:
have powerful := fun m => ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ m → p ^ 2 ∣ m;
have StewartHyp :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ),
    3 ≤ q →
      ∀ (a : Fin (q + 1) → ℤ),
        Finset.univ.gcd a = 1 →
          Squarefree
              (∑ i, MvPolynomial.C ↑(a i) * MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ ↑i * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ (q - ↑i)) →
            ∀ (m : ℤ),
              m ≠ 0 →
                {rs | rs.1.gcd rs.2 = 1 ∧ ∑ i, a i * rs.1 ^ ↑i * rs.2 ^ (q - ↑i) = m}.encard ≤
                  ↑(2800 * q ^ (1 + m.natAbs.primeFactors.card));
have CCDN12 := fun c =>
  ∀ (d : ℕ),
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 12) ℚ)),
        I.IsPrime →
          ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 12) ℚ ⧸ I) = 1 →
            (∃ e s₀,
                ∀ (s : ℕ),
                  s₀ ≤ s →
                    ↑(Module.finrank ℚ
                          ↥(Submodule.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℚ I).toLinearMap
                              (MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree (Fin 12) ℚ s))) =
                      ↑d * ↑s + e) →
              ∀ (B : ℝ),
                1 ≤ B →
                  ↑{P |
                          (∀ f ∈ I, (MvPolynomial.eval fun i => ↑(P i)) f = 0) ∧
                            ∀ (i : Fin 12), |↑(P i)| ≤ B}.ncard ≤
                    c * ↑d ^ 3 * B ^ (1 / ↑d) * (Real.log B + ↑d);
have Gelfond :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ),
    ∃ c,
      0 ≤ c ∧
        ∀ (F G : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ℤ),
          F ≠ 0 →
            G ∣ F →
              ∀ (H : ℝ),
                (∀ (m : Fin n →₀ ℕ), |↑(MvPolynomial.coeff m F)| ≤ H) →
                  ∀ (m : Fin n →₀ ℕ),
                    |↑(MvPolynomial.coeff m G)| ≤ Real.exp (c * ↑F.totalDegree) * H;
StewartHyp →
  (∃ c, CCDN12 c) →
    Gelfond →
      (∀ (k : ℕ),
          3 ≤ k →
            ∀ (ε : ℝ),
              0 < ε →
                ∃ C X0,
                  0 < C ∧
                    1 ≤ X0 ∧
                      ∀ (x : ℝ),
                        X0 ≤ x →
                          ↑{n | ↑n ≤ x ∧ powerful (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (n + i))}.ncard ≤
                            C * x ^ (77 / 320 + ε)) ∧
        ∀ (k : ℕ),
          3 ≤ k →
            ∀ (ε : ℝ),
              0 < ε →
                ∃ C X0,
                  0 < C ∧
                    1 ≤ X0 ∧
                      ∀ (x : ℝ),
                        X0 ≤ x →
                          ↑{n |
                                  ↑n ≤ x ∧
                                    powerful (∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (n + i)) ∧
                                      ∀ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 3,
                                        (↑n + 3) ^ (19 / 100) <
                                            ↑(∏ p ∈ (n + i).primeFactors with
                                                k ≤ p ∧ Odd ((n + i).factorization p), p) ∧
                                          ↑(∏ p ∈ (n + i).primeFactors with
                                                k ≤ p ∧ Odd ((n + i).factorization p), p) <
                                            (↑n + 3) ^ (21 / 100)}.ncard ≤
                            C * x ^ (38059 / 160000 + ε)

declarations.statement:

            ∀ (m : ℤ),
              m ≠ 0 →
                {rs | rs.1.gcd rs.2 = 1 ∧ ∑ i, a i * rs.1 ^ ↑i * rs.2 ^ (q - ↑i) = m}.encard ≤
                  ↑(2800 * q ^ (1 + m.natAbs.primeFactors.card));
have CCDN12 := fun c =>
  ∀ (d : ℕ),
    1 ≤ d →
      ∀ (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 12) ℚ)),
        I.IsPrime →
          ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 12) ℚ ⧸ I) = 1 →
            (∃ e s₀,
                ∀ (s : ℕ),
                  s₀ ≤ s →
                    ↑(Module.finrank ℚ
                          ↥(Submodule.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ ℚ I).toLinearMap
                              (MvPolynomial.restrictTotalDegree (Fin 12) ℚ s))) =
                      ↑d * ↑s + e) →
              ∀ (B : ℝ),
                1 ≤ B →
                  ↑{P |
